entries.en: A quiet home for your photos

entries.zh: 你的照片仍在本机。可以重试，或导出诊断信息。
entries.en: Your photos are still on this device. You can retry or export diagnostics.

entries.zh: 原数据库无法读取，已自动备份并新建空库。照片文件未受影响，可重新导入。
entries.en: The previous database could not be read. It was backed up and a new empty library was created. Your photo files are untouched; you can import again.

entries.zh: 把这台平板变成家里的相框。三步：选择照片、挑选展示内容、开始播放。
entries.en: Turn this tablet into a picture frame. Three steps: choose photos, pick what to display, start the slideshow.

entries.zh: 这是示例照片，不会加入你的照片库。
entries.en: These are sample photos. They won’t be added to your library.

entries.zh: 创建一个相框，选择要展示的照片。
entries.en: Create a frame and choose the photos to display.

entries.zh: 只删除这个相框的展示设置，照片不会被删除。
entries.en: This removes the frame’s settings only. Your photos will not be deleted.

entries.zh: 播放正在另一个窗口进行
entries.en: The slideshow is playing in another window

entries.zh: 添加一个来源，把照片导入到这台设备。
entries.en: Add a source to import photos onto this device.

entries.zh: 导入后，你仍可选择展示哪些照片。
entries.en: After importing, choose which photos to display.

entries.zh: 保留已导入的本地照片
entries.en: Keep imported photos on this device

entries.zh: 将停止同步并删除保存的连接信息。
entries.en: Syncing stops and saved connection details are removed.

entries.zh: 从系统照片库选择照片，或从文件应用导入图片。
entries.en: Choose photos from the photo library, or import images from Files.

entries.zh: 从系统文件中选择图片，包括 iCloud 云盘中的文件。
entries.en: Choose images from Files, including iCloud Drive.

entries.zh: 从这台设备的系统照片库读取，云端照片会先下载到本机。
entries.en: Reads from this device’s photo library. Cloud photos download to this device first.

entries.zh: 请先将 iCloud 照片导出到本地，再从文件导入。
entries.en: Export your iCloud photos to this device first, then import from Files.

entries.zh: 不需要输入 Apple ID 密码。
entries.en: No Apple ID password is required.

entries.zh: 开启后会持续检查该相册的新照片，需要照片库访问权限。
entries.en: Checks the album for new photos. Requires photo library access.

entries.zh: 选择 Google Photos 照片
在 Google 官方页面选择照片，选中的照片会下载到本机。
entries.en: Pick photos on Google’s own page. Selected photos are downloaded to this device.

entries.zh: 不会自动同步你的全部 Google 相册；新增照片需要再次选择。
entries.en: This does not sync your entire Google library. Choose again to add new photos.

entries.zh: 正在打开 Google 选择页面
请在浏览器中完成选择
暂不支持 Google 相册
这个来源还在准备中，当前版本无法使用。
entries.en: This source is still being prepared and can’t be used in this version.

entries.zh: 该来源的照片保留方式仍在确认中。
entries.en: How photos from this source may be kept is still being confirmed.

entries.zh: 连接家中的 NAS，按目录导入照片。
entries.en: Connect your home NAS and import photos by folder.

entries.zh: 源文件被删除时，本机副本也会删除，包括已加入相框的照片。
entries.en: When a file is deleted at the source, its copy here is deleted too, including photos used in frames.

entries.zh: 即将删除本机 {count} 张照片

en.one: {count} photo will be deleted from this device
en.other: {count} photos will be deleted from this device

entries.zh: 为了连接家里的 NAS，PhotoPilot 需要访问同一网络中的设备。照片只在本机处理。
entries.en: To reach your home NAS, PhotoPilot needs to find devices on your network. Photos stay on this device.

entries.zh: 无法连接局域网中的 NAS。已导入的照片仍可正常播放。
entries.en: PhotoPilot can’t reach your NAS. Photos you already imported still play normally.

entries.zh: 用于连接你在局域网中的 NAS，读取你选择的照片。
entries.en: Used to connect to your NAS on the local network and read the photos you choose.

entries.zh: 这台服务器的证书无法自动验证。请确认指纹与你的 NAS 一致。
entries.en: This server’s certificate can’t be verified automatically. Check that the fingerprint matches your NAS.
The certificate doesn’t match this address

entries.zh: 这些服务器的证书指纹已被你信任，可随时撤销。
entries.en: These servers’ certificate fingerprints are trusted by you and can be revoked at any time.

entries.zh: 这台服务器的证书与上次不同。如果不是你更换了证书，请不要继续。
entries.en: This server’s certificate differs from last time. If you didn’t change it, don’t continue.

entries.zh: 用户名、密码和照片会以明文传输。仅建议在你信任的家庭网络中使用。
entries.en: Your username, password, and photos would be sent unencrypted. Use this only on a home network you trust.

entries.zh: 公网地址不允许未加密连接。
entries.en: Unencrypted connections to public addresses are not allowed.
Photos already imported will be kept.

entries.zh: 取消并删除本批已导入
请重新授权以继续导入
entries.en: Allow access again to continue importing

entries.note: 导入完成后选择展示内容时：已有相框则让用户挑选
导入后选择展示内容：新建相框选项

entries.zh: Live Photo 将保存为静态照片
entries.en: Live Photos will be saved as still images

entries.en: All {total} items are already in the library — nothing new to import

entries.en: This photo can’t be shown right now

entries.zh: 自动加入这个目录的新照片
entries.en: Include new photos from this folder

entries.zh: 新照片会自动显示在这个相框中。
entries.en: New photos will appear in this frame automatically.
Touch and hold, then drag to reorder.
New photos were added to the end.

entries.zh: 从本机删除 {count} 张照片？
这会删除本机副本，并影响 {frames} 个相框。源文件不会被删除。

en.one: This deletes the copies on this device and affects {frames} frame.
en.other: This deletes the copies on this device and affects {frames} frames. Files at the source are not deleted.

entries.zh: 这张照片会从所有相框中移除，并且不会再被导入。
entries.en: It will be removed from every frame and won’t be imported again.

entries.zh: 只清理缩略图等可重新生成的文件，不影响你的照片。
entries.en: Clears thumbnails and other files that can be regenerated. Your photos are untouched.

entries.zh: 会删除本机照片副本、相框、设置和保存的连接信息。系统照片和 NAS 上的原文件不受影响。
entries.en: This erases photo copies, frames, settings, and saved connections on this device. Your system photo library and files on your NAS are not affected.

entries.zh: 重新导入已删除的照片
网络已断开，继续播放本地照片

entries.en: Choose photos to display, or check the download progress.

entries.en: Some photos couldn’t be shown and were skipped
Only one photo is on display

entries.en: The current photo is no longer shown. Switched to a safe screen.

entries.zh: 已降低画面效果以保持稳定
entries.en: Visual effects reduced to stay stable

entries.en: How long each photo stays fully visible

entries.en: How long the change between photos lasts

entries.zh: 选择“无转场”时不需要设置时长。
entries.en: No duration is needed when transitions are off.

entries.zh: 完整展示 · 模糊补边
完整展示 · 纯色补边
裁剪铺满可能裁掉照片边缘。
entries.en: Fill and crop may crop the edges of your photos.

新设置将从下一张照片开始生效。
entries.en: New settings start with the next photo.

entries.zh: 只用于获取天气，不会持续定位。
entries.en: Used only to get the weather. Your location isn’t tracked.

entries.en: Weather is off. The clock still shows.

entries.en: Used to get the weather for your city while you use the app.

entries.en: System dialogs use your device’s language settings.

entries.en: The system may delay background syncing. You may need to wake the device after it locks.

entries.zh: 这段时间内暂停播放并调暗屏幕。
entries.en: Pauses the slideshow and dims the screen during these hours.

entries.zh: 开始与结束时间不能相同
entries.en: Start and end times must be different

entries.zh: 照片只在这台设备上处理，不会上传。
entries.en: Photos are processed on this device and never uploaded.

entries.zh: 导出前会移除照片名、地址和凭证。
entries.en: Photo names, addresses, and credentials are removed before export.

entries.en: Built-in tracks are original compositions synthesized for this app and licensed together with it.

entries.en: Used to save photos to your library when you export them.

entries.en: Used to let you know when an import finishes or needs your attention.

entries.en: The server’s certificate changed. Please confirm it again.

entries.en: Unencrypted connections are allowed only on your local network and need your per-device confirmation. Public addresses never allow plaintext.
